chapters.text: How much can a coin tell you? A fair coin has one bit of uncertainty. Follow that question into Bucket.
Start with a question. Explore searches research sources from the desktop.
Keep a useful result. Your saved papers remain here when you return.
Search the bundled Canon for entropy. Open a result to follow the idea to its source.
Learn, Path, Quiz, and Review connect study with practice. Start with a bundled course or add your own material.
Write down the question and keep the source beside it. Notes are saved on this computer.
Analyze data accepts tables from your own files. Data and History keep the work within reach.
Bring your own material into the workspace. Try the coin example on the download page, then take Bucket with you.
